Scope: SQL Server 2008-2025 Windows Database Engine (Microsoft Learn build lists). GDR rows identify the servicing security floor; CU currency is reported separately. 2008-2016 branches are per service pack (e.g. SP3-CU, SP4-GDR). Other releases and unlisted builds require review.
LifecycleNote: End of extended support per major version (Microsoft Fixed Lifecycle Policy); Extended Security Updates are not considered. ExtendedSupportEnds is null when the date was not confirmed at review time. Kept by tools/Update-SqlSecurityReference.ps1; maintain it by hand.
